angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 551,690 km at 55.04 pc = 0.13 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 18.1671 +/- 0.0126 mas (same row, RUWE 1.08): 55.04 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.793 +/- 0.036 solar radii from Deeg et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..12D/abstract): 551,690 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.798 +/- 0.035 solar masses from Deeg et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..12D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4884 +/- 70 K from Deeg et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..12D/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Deeg et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..12D/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1416.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.542, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1416 (pscomppars): spectral type G9 V, from Deeg et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..12D/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+42 2504: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1416 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.08 dex, from Deeg et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..12D/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1416 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.46008, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1416 (pscomppars): age 6.9 Gyr, from Deeg et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..12D/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1416 (pscomppars): rotation period 17.6 d, from Deeg et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..12D/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1416 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Deeg et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..12D/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.793 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.877. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
